notes.title: NPC Dialogue and Gameplay demo
notes.notes:
Join the developer for a personal walk-through of the gameplay systems of Voxabular P.I.

We'll get to know the characters by chatting with them in open dialogue, and show how the conversation hints help you direct the conversation to advance the plot.

We'll also show the puzzle solving mechanic where you can manipulate the objects using text commands.

And yes, you'll do this all while learning Spanish!

I promise you, you've never seen anything quite like Voxabular P.I.

Come on over and ask some questions!

Looking forward to seeing you there.
